description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance Call out with Effect From June 22,2024 all the Members of the Armed Forces.
categorisation: This gazette content involves the exercise of powers under the Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) to call out armed forces for maintaining public order. It constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it represents an official order made under statutory authority, specifically invoking and implementing provisions of existing legislation (the Public Security Ordinance). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories, making it a legal/regulatory gazette.
